items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: The colour, radius, spacing, type, shadow, motion and layout tokens every item renders with, and the Mona Sans font.
items.docs: Adds the light and dark colour variables, the radius, spacing and type scales, the popover shadow, the motion, z-index and container tokens, and the Mona Sans font to your CSS file. Every component item in this registry depends on it. Install it once, before your first component: shadcn replaces the variables you already have with these only when a theme item is named in the command, not when it arrives as a dependency, so installing it again later replaces any of these variables you have edited. The colour variables use the shadcn/ui names. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/tokens

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Joins and merges class names, and resolves the token utilities so a className override replaces them.
items.docs: Import cn from @/lib/cn and pass it class names; a later class replaces an earlier one in the same group, token utilities such as text-micro, shadow-popover and duration-quick included. Every component item in this registry imports it. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/lib/cn

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: A list of 44px rows, each part named for the rank of what it holds, with one tab stop, arrow-key focus, keyboard peek and keyboard selection.
items.docs: List holds ListRow children, and every ListRow part ships in this item. In each row, rank each value, then compose: an optional ListRowSelect (a row without one cannot be selected), then ListRowLink holding ListRowSubject (rank 1: an optional ListRowId, an optional ListRowMedia, then ListRowName, then an optional one-line ListRowDescription) and one ListRowFact per rank 2 fact, at most eight, then an optional ListRowPeek, a button that toggles peek on the row so a click on ListRowLink can open the item's page. ListRowMedia holds a status or entity and draws only its media (variant default), or one muted icon (variant icon, with a label screen readers read in place of the icon). Media drawn alone needs a PreviewCard on it that shows the word, and peek or the item's page to reach it by keyboard. Hold a status, entity, figure, meter or relative-time in each ListRowFact, or set missing to unavailable when the value failed to load or hidden when the viewer's role cannot see it, and state why once outside the list. Rank 4 is a preview-card on a rank 1 or 2 value; rank 5 is the item's page, reached through ListRowLink's render, and peek, rendered from List's peekValue, previews part of it read-only. Columns line up down the list. When the list narrows the description truncates, then the name; below 640px the description is hidden; set narrow="abbreviate" to switch a part to its short form below 768px, or narrow="hide" to drop it below 640px, and keep a hidden value in peek and on the item's page. While loading, render ListRowLoading with the same parts. The list is one tab stop. ↑ ↓ Home End move focus, Space toggles peek on the focused row (an open peek follows focus), X toggles selection on a row that has a ListRowSelect, Esc closes peek and then clears the selection. List renders no peek: read peekValue with onPeekValueChange and render a read-only preview of the item's page beside the list or in a drawer at wide widths, and under the row or in a bottom drawer at narrow ones; it holds nothing that page lacks. Show the key hints in text near the list and point aria-describedby at them. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/components/list

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A table for comparing values down a column, replacing shadcn/ui's Table: every table element as a part, sortable headers, child and group rows, selection and peek, with one tab stop.
items.docs: Use it where shadcn/ui's Table goes: Table holds TableCaption, then TableColumnGroup with TableColumn, then TableHeader, TableBody and TableFooter, each holding TableRow with TableHead and TableCell. TableCaption names the table. A TableHead in TableHeader names a column; in a body or footer row it names the row. Set align="end" on a numeric column's head and cells to right-align it in tabular figures, and narrow="abbreviate" or narrow="hide" on a column's head and cells alike to shorten it below 768px or remove it below 640px; keep a hidden value in peek, on the row's page or in a TableCellDetail under the row's name. Pass sort, expandedValues, selectedValues or peekValue (or their default and on...Change props) and the table becomes a treegrid with one tab stop on its rows: give every body TableRow a value and a level. A TableHead with a column then sorts by it; one column is sorted at a time and you sort the rows yourself. A record row holds TableRowLink, to its page, inside its row header, an optional TableRowSelect (a row without one cannot be selected) and a TableRowExpand when it has child rows; render child rows after it with level one higher, only while it is expanded. TableGroupRow heads a group: give it values, the rows it selects together, and keep its counts and sums when collapsed. While loading, render TableRowLoading with the same cells. Keys: up and down, Home and End move between rows; right expands, then moves in; left collapses, then moves to the parent; up from the first row reaches the headers. Enter opens the row's link, Space peeks it, and both toggle a group; X or Shift+Space selects; Esc closes peek, then clears the selection. The table renders no peek: read peekValue and render a read-only preview beside the table or under the row. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/components/table

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A state drawn as a shape-coded dot and its name, with an optional description.
items.docs: Compose StatusMedia (fill none, half or full), then StatusName, then an optional one-line StatusDescription. The dot tells states apart by shape, not colour. The description truncates before the name. In a ListRowMedia, and in an abbreviated ListRowFact, only the dot is drawn and the name and description are read by screen readers. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/components/status

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: One person or team drawn as their picture or initials, and a group of avatars that overlap and spread apart on hover, on Base UI Avatar.
items.docs: Compose Avatar holding an AvatarImage and an AvatarFallback with the initials; shape square draws a team. The avatar is hidden from screen readers, so put the name beside it or in the accessible name of the control around it. AvatarGroup draws three avatars, then +N for the rest; render it as a popover trigger whose popup lists everyone, and pass label, since its avatars are hidden from screen readers. Draw a person's name with entity, which composes Avatar. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/components/avatar

items.name: entity
items.title: Entity
items.description: A person, team or organisation drawn as its initials or picture in a 24px avatar, then its name.
items.docs: Compose EntityMedia holding an AvatarImage and an AvatarFallback with the initials, or the initials alone, then EntityName, then an optional one-line EntityDescription. The media is hidden from screen readers, so EntityName carries the name. The description truncates before the name. In a ListRowMedia, and in an abbreviated ListRowFact, only the media is drawn and the name and description are read by screen readers. Wrap it in a preview-card to show more about the entity. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/components/entity

items.name: figure
items.title: Figure
items.description: A number the caller compares down a list, in tabular figures, with a compact short form.
items.docs: Pass value and Intl.NumberFormat options in format, and a locale so server and browser render the same text. It sits at the end of its column. In an abbreviated ListRowFact it switches to compact notation, such as $13K. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/components/figure

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measurement within a known range, drawn as a bar and its value, on Base UI Meter.
items.docs: Pass value, min and max, a format and an aria-label. In an abbreviated ListRowFact the bar is dropped and the value stays. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/components/meter

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Relative time
items.description: A moment stated relative to now, with a narrow short form.
items.docs: Pass dateTime and now as ISO 8601 strings; passing now keeps server and browser output the same. In an abbreviated ListRowFact it switches to the narrow form, such as 2h ago. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/components/relative-time

items.name: preview-card
items.title: Preview card
items.description: Rank 4: a hover card on a rank 1 or 2 value with more about that entity or property.
items.docs: Compose PreviewCard, PreviewCardTrigger around the value, then PreviewCardContent. It opens 300ms after the pointer enters and closes when it leaves; the trigger is not focusable, so every field in the card must also appear in peek and on the item's page. It may hold links. The card renders into the body; pass PreviewCardContent a container to render it inside a scaled or panned surface instead. Playground: https://design-system.wpei.me/playground/components/preview-card
